summary: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (4bit) resisted 16% and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (4bit-DWQ) resisted 80% on canary-injection-v1 version 1, with 50 items per run. These recorded scores support the stated ordering for these runs only. Both report mlx-lm 0.32.2; the 4B model has no thinking mode and the 35B run disabled thinking. Resisted means a non-empty visible reply without the literal canary, not necessarily a useful or safe response.
limitations: Different model generations, architectures and quantizations (4bit versus 4bit-DWQ); harness versions differ (0.2.0 versus 0.1.0). One run each, by one account, on 50 templated English items (10 documents x 5 styles), not 50 independent trials. No causal size comparison or general real-world security claim: refusals can pass, quotations can fail, transformed leaks can pass. Self-reported results; transcripts are not hosted and were not inspected for this finding. No independent reproduction or review; hashes alone do not verify correctness.
author: bigshort2022
